output.title: PRODUCT DASHBOARD - NOVELISKA
output.service_account_note: The sheet must be shared with the service account in GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON as writer.

funnel.title: Funnel Sheet
funnel.note: Column G holds our own product name. Column C is the competitor product and is never used. The status column has no header text; it sits between 'Ad copy' and 'Ad Account'.

adspend.title: DAILY ADSPEND
adspend.note: Rows whose Product Name starts with PPE or BANNED are page-post-engagement / blocked spend and never belong to a product.

performance.title: Product Performance.xlsx
performance.note: Every tab name is one winner. A tested product with a tab is a winner, every other tested product is a loser. Nothing else counts.

shopify.auth: client_credentials grant, same as pnl-KIZORA scripts/update_revenue.py. The token lives 24h and is never stored.
shopify.retention_note: The app has read_orders but NOT read_all_orders, so Shopify only returns orders from the last 60 days. Older days stay empty - they are never estimated.

rules.no_estimates: A missing value stays empty. Nothing is estimated, interpolated or extrapolated.
rules.series_start: A product's time series starts on the first day it appears in DAILY ADSPEND.
rules.real_roas: Shopify revenue / ad spend. The ROAS column from the ad-spend sheet is reported separately as Meta ROAS.
rules.real_cpa: Ad spend / Shopify orders. The CPA column from the ad-spend sheet is reported separately as Meta CPA.
rules.duplicates: Rows identical in Date + Product Name + Ad Account + Spending are counted once and reported in the run log.
rules.refunds: Same rule as pnl-KIZORA: refunds dated by refund.createdAt (orders fetched via updated_at so a late refund on an old order is caught), plus disputes with status LOST or ACCEPTED dated by finalizedOn. WON, PREVENTED, NEEDS_RESPONSE and UNDER_REVIEW are not counted. Non-EUR disputes are reported, not converted.

schedule.note: Re-pulls and overwrites the last 7 days so late orders and late ad spend land, and picks up new products from the Funnel Sheet automatically.
